Metadata.title: Isula
Metadata.description: Sicily as locals know it, made for you: itineraries built on your preferences and products shipped by the producers.
Metadata.tagline: Sicily as locals know it, made for you.

Home.title: Sicily as locals know it, made for you.
Home.subtitle: Tell us what you love and how much time you have: we suggest an itinerary built on your preferences, with the practical tips you only get from people who live here.
Home.eyebrow: Travel planner and produce from the island
Home.stepsTitle: Three steps, then off you go
Home.step1Text: Sea, food, history, pace, budget, whether you have a car. You can change everything at any time.
Home.step2Text: Day by day, with times, transfers and the reason for each stop. Edit it yourself or ask the assistant.
Home.step3Text: You book activities with our partners. What you tasted on the trip comes home, shipped by the producers.
Home.readyTitle: Start here, then change what you like

Login.title: Sign in
Login.description: We email you a code: type it here and you're in. If the email is new, we create the account.
Login.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. Type it below.
Login.linkAlternative: The email also has a sign-in link: it works if you open it in this browser.
Login.openInBrowser: Google doesn't allow sign-in from the {app, select, instagram {Instagram} facebook {Facebook} tiktok {TikTok} other {in-app}} browser. Use the email code, or open the page in your browser from the ⋯ menu at the top.
Login.guestText: You can also use Isula without an account: create and save your trips, and link them to your email whenever you like.
Login.guestCodeSent: We sent a code to {email}. Type it below to save your account.

errors.invalid_code: That code isn't right. Check the latest email you received.

errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.email_taken: This email already has an account. To use it, sign out and sign in with the code: trips created as a guest don't move to that account.
errors.not_guest: Your account already has an email.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Guest.title: You're using Isula as a guest
Guest.description: The trips you create are saved on this device. Add your email to find them anywhere: they stay yours, nothing is lost.
Guest.signOutWarning: If you sign out without saving the account, trips created as a guest can't be recovered.
